title: Migration Dry Run
objective: Menjalankan migrasi pada salinan reference projects dan membandingkan data sebelum/sesudah.

implementation.source_mutation_policy: copy_before_open; source package is never opened for writing

required_outputs.migration_logs: Ordered log entries identify copy and production open phases.
required_outputs.record_counts: Every non-internal SQLite table is counted before and after the dry run.
required_outputs.link_counts: Link, relation, and reference table counts are reported separately.
required_outputs.checksum_results: Manifest SHA-256 is compared between source and disposable target.
required_outputs.warnings: Count changes are surfaced as warnings; they are not silently repaired.
required_outputs.repair_actions: No automatic repair is performed during a dry run.

fixture_policy: Uses a disposable ProjectPackage created under the OS temp directory; never reads or writes user projects.
limits: This slice proves one synthetic reference package and local migration/open behavior.
Native GUI, hosted CI, signing, and release publication remain outside this evidence.
